Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_Failure;
 if :thaw_method is null
 then
 NEXT_ITEM;
 if :system.cursor_record != 1
 then
 DUPLICATE_ITEM;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 DUPLICATE_ITEM;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 end if;
 else
 begin
 select distinct bag_id into :bag_id
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = trunc(:coll_date) and
 product_code = :new_product_code;
 exception
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 /* Allow Freeze Time entry only if it is defined in master codes
 for code = FCRYO */
 BEGIN
 select 'x'
 INTO :global.x
 FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'FCRYO'
 AND code = :ctrl_blk_1.new_product_code
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1);
 GO_ITEM('freeze_time');
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('0286');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END; 
 IF :system.cursor_record != 1
 then
 DUPLICATE_ITEM;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_bag_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_add_on_bags number;
 temp_no_of_comp number;
 temp_no_of_bags number;
 temp_no_of_discards number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_red_tube_flag VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 temp_bleed_end_time date;
 temp_sep_ind number(1);
 timer_id TIMER;

 v_gmt_time date;
 v_freeze_time date;
 --v_local_time date;
 
v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;
begin
 -- time zone change --5/16/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 if :coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 begin
 select thaw_method, thaw_temperature,
 dummy_product_code, actual_product_code,
 freeze_time, cryo_ok_flag, sep_ind
 into :thaw_method, :thaw_temperature,
 :old_product_code, :new_product_code,
 --MS :freeze_time, 
 v_freeze_time, --MS
 :cryo_ok_flag, temp_sep_ind
 from cryo_units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = trunc(:coll_date);

 --MS Converting GMT time to Local time.
 if v_freeze_time is not null then
 if :global.is_time_enabled = 'Y' then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, v_freeze_time, v_local_time);
 :freeze_time := v_local_time;
 else
 :freeze_time := v_freeze_time;
 end if;
 end if;
 --MS 
 
 IF :new_product_code is not null THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x'
 INTO :GLOBAL.x
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
 and coll_date = trunc(:Coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and product_code = :new_product_code;
 
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 BEGIN 
 select c.product_code
 into :new_product_code
 from components c, valid_products vp
 where vp.product_code = substr(c.product_code, 1,5) 
 and unit_id = :unit_id
 and coll_date = trunc(:coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and vp.product_type = 'CRYO'
 and v_sysdate between vp.eff_date and nvl(vp.term_date, to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+1);
 
 IF :freeze_time is not null THEN
 :freeze_time := null;
 END IF;
 
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 null;
 END;
 
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 END IF;

 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0186');
 check_package_failure;
 
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 
 end;

 if temp_sep_ind = 3
 then
 begin
 select third_sep_weight, third_sep_centrifuge_id,
 third_sep_time
 into :sep_weight, :centrifuge_id, :sep_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = trunc(:coll_date);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 else
 if temp_sep_ind = 2
 then
 begin
 select second_sep_weight,
 second_sep_centrifuge_id,
 second_sep_time
 into :sep_weight, :centrifuge_id,
 :sep_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = trunc(:coll_date);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
 
 if :freeze_time is not null
 then
 message
 ('Msg:Complete details for CRYO separation have been entered.',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE);
 timer_id := CREATE_TIMER('exit_timer',1500) ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if;

 if :thaw_method is null
 then
 --
 -- note that we don't check for presence of an
 -- additional bag because the CRYO stays in the same
 -- bag as the Destined CRYO bag
 --
 begin
 -- to check if the bag code
 select substr(bag_code,2,1) , nvl(add_on_bags,0),
 bleed_start_time, bleed_end_time,
 first_sep_weight, second_sep_weight,
 first_sep_time, second_sep_time
 into temp_bag_code, temp_add_on_bags,
 temp_bleed_start_time, temp_bleed_end_time,
 :GLOBAL.first_sep_weight,
 :GLOBAL.second_sep_weight,
 :GLOBAL.first_sep_time, :GLOBAL.second_sep_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if (temp_bleed_start_time is null or
 temp_bleed_end_time is null)
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0065');
 end if;
 
 default_value('','GLOBAL.bag_code');
 reconcile_bags(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,temp_count,
 :GLOBAL.bag_code);
 check_package_failure;
 
 if :GLOBAL.bag_code is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0039');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 :GLOBAL.second_sep := 'N';
 :GLOBAL.third_sep := 'N';
 
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 second_sep_time is not null;
 :GLOBAL.third_sep := 'Y';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.second_sep := 'Y';
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in checking for platelets');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 end if;

 if :new_product_code is not null
 then
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :new_product_code and
 (system_label_decision is null or
 system_label_decision in ('39','71'));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0099');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 
end;

Item.Name: OLD_PRODUCT_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter value for product code to be converted or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 v_local_time date;
 v_sysdate date;
begin
 /* -- new tz function
 -- time zone change --5/16/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 */ 
 
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE); -- new tz function
 
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 --
 -- A component already pooled or relabeled cannot
 -- be converted simply because it does not exist
 -- anymore
 --
 select distinct a.product_code, product_desc,
 bag_id, product_type
 into :old_product_code, :s_old_desc,
 :GLOBAL.old_bag_id, :old_product_type
 from components a, valid_products b
 where a.unit_id = :unit_id and
 a.chapter_id = :chapter_id and
 trunc(a.coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 a.product_code = :old_product_code and
 a.component_status = 'L' and
 a.reject_reason_code is null and
 b.product_type = 'DUFFP' and
 a.product_code = b.product_code and
 b.unit_scheme_type='C' and
 v_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_old_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 CHECK_INTRANSIT_INTERDICTION (:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.old_product_code,
 null, 
 :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 'INTR');
 begin
 -- Split components cannot be converted
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 product_code = :old_product_code;
 if temp_count > 1
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0157');
 check_package_Failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Item.Name: NEW_PRODUCT_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter value for the new product code or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_set_id number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_valid_set VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_valid_prod VARCHAR2(1);
 cursor c1 is
 select set_id from product_matrix
 where product_type = :new_product_type
 and bag_code = :GLOBAL.bag_code;
 cursor c2 is
 select distinct product_code
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code != 'NONE' and
 product_code != :old_product_code and
 relabel_product_code is null;
 -- pooled components are inclusive
 -- relabeled components are not considered
 -- in the search for an optimal
 -- combination
 v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;
begin
 /* -- new tz function
 -- time zone change --5/16/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 */ 
 
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE); -- new tz function.
 
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select product_code, product_desc, product_type
 into :new_product_code, :s_new_desc, :new_product_type
 from valid_products
 where product_code = :new_product_code and
 product_type = 'CRYO' and
 unit_scheme_type= 'C' and
 v_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_new_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from valid_product_conv
 where target_product_code = :new_product_code and
 source_product_code = :old_product_code and
 v_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_new_desc := '';
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0149');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :new_product_code;
 -- relabeled and pooled components are
 -- considered as components made from the unit
 if temp_count != 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0159');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 IF :old_product_type != :new_product_type THEN
 begin
 temp_valid_set := 'N';
 for temp_set in c1 loop
 temp_valid_set := 'N';
 temp_valid_prod := 'Y';
 for temp_prod in c2 loop
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from product_matrix
 where set_id=temp_set.set_id
 and product_type = (SELECT product_type 
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code = temp_prod.product_code
 AND v_sysdate between eff_date 
 and nvl(term_date, to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 temp_valid_prod := 'N';
 exit;

declare
 v_gmt_time date;
 
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_Failure;
 :Global.err_cnt := 'N'; -- IM# 2510

--MS
 if :freeze_time is not null then
 --MS Converting Local time to GMT.
 if :global.is_time_enabled = 'Y' then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :freeze_time, v_gmt_time); 
 :global.freeze_time := to_char(v_gmt_time, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI');
 else

 end if;
 end if;
--
 
 --MS if :freeze_time <= :sep_time
 if to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI') <= :sep_time --MS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 show_error('0058');
 check_package_Failure;
 end if;
 
 if nvl(:global.err_cnt, 'N') != 'Y' then
 --MS if :freeze_time > sysdate
 if to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI') > sysdate --MS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 show_error('0141');

 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then

end;

declare

begin
 if :Global.err_cnt = 'N' then 
 :Global.err_cnt := 'Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 end if;
 if error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then-- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

declare
 temp_time_limit number(5,2);
 temp_max_temp number(5,2);
 temp_checkin_min_temp number(5,2);
 temp_product_weight number(5,2);
 temp_production_time number(5,2);
 temp_min_ws_freeze_time number(5,2);
 temp_max_ws_freeze_time number(5,2);
 temp_min_sep_freeze_time number(5,2);
 temp_max_sep_freeze_time number(5,2);
 temp_ws_insert_dats date;
 temp_product_type VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_time_difference VARCHAR2(10);
 current_dats date;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 savepoint all_clear;
 begin
 select nvl(min_ws_freeze_time,-99),
 nvl(max_ws_freeze_time,99),
 nvl(min_sep_freeze_time,-99),
 nvl(max_sep_freeze_time,99)
 into temp_min_ws_freeze_time, temp_max_ws_freeze_time,
 temp_min_sep_freeze_time, temp_max_sep_freeze_time
 from valid_cryo_methods
 where thaw_method = :thaw_method and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :cryo_ok_flag = 'N'
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :new_product_code,
 'CRYO',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdiction CRYO not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 -- check if the time interval between making the
 -- worksheet and freezing of the CRYO exceeds the allowable
 -- range
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'N';
 begin
 select insert_dats
 into temp_ws_insert_dats
 from cryo_units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('2');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
/* MS
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_ws_insert_dats,:freeze_time);
*/

 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_ws_insert_dats,to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'));

 if temp_time_difference is null
 then
 -- time difference is more than 999 hours or some
 -- other
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'Y';
 else
 temp_time_difference :=
 translate(temp_time_difference,':','.');
 if to_number(temp_time_difference) not between
 temp_min_ws_freeze_time and
 temp_max_ws_freeze_time
 then
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'Y';
 end if;
 end if;

 if :GLOBAL.time_interdiction = 'Y'
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :new_product_code,
 'CRWS',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdiction CRWS not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 
 -- check if the time interval between making the
 -- separation and freezing of the CRYO exceeds the allowable
 -- range
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'N';

/* MS 
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(:sep_time,:freeze_time);
*/

 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(:sep_time,to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'));

 if temp_time_difference is null
 then
 -- time difference is more than 999 hours or some
 -- other
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'Y';
 else
 temp_time_difference :=
 translate(temp_time_difference,':','.');
 if to_number(temp_time_difference) not between
 temp_min_sep_freeze_time and
 temp_max_sep_freeze_time
 then
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'Y';
 end if;
 end if;

 if :GLOBAL.time_interdiction = 'Y'
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :new_product_code,
 'CRSE',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdiction CRSE not assigned to component');

RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select equip_id centrifuge_id, serial_number manufacturer from equipment where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and equip_type='CENT' and status = 'IN' and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between first_production_date and nvl(last_production_date, sysdate + 365) order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_BAG_ID_LOV3
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code, code_desc from master_codes, valid_product_bag_id b where b.product_code = :new_product_code and code_type = 'BAGID' and b.bag_id = code and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, sysdate + 365) and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between master_codes.eff_date and nvl(master_codes.term_date, sysdate + 365) order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_NEW_PRODUCT_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT product_code, product_desc
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE unit_scheme_type ='C'
 AND lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset,SYSDATE) BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, sysdate + 365)
 AND product_type = 'CRYO'
 AND product_code NOT IN
 (SELECT DISTINCT product_code
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
 AND TO_CHAR(coll_date,'MM-DD-RR') = TO_CHAR(:coll_date,'MM-DD-RR')
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 )
 /* pooled components and relabeled components also inclusive */
ORDER BY product_code

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_OLD_PRODUCT_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT product_code, product_desc
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_type = 'DUFFP'
 AND 1 =
 (SELECT COUNT(*)
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND TO_CHAR(coll_date,'MM-DD-YY') = TO_CHAR(:coll_date,'MM-DD-YY')
 AND product_code = valid_products.product_code
 AND reject_reason_code IS NULL
 AND component_status = 'L'
 )
 AND unit_scheme_type='C'
 AND lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset,SYSDATE) BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,sysdate+365)
 /* a product that has been pooled or relabeled already cannot be
 converted again. therefore, they are present in the where clause;
 also, components split cannot be used for conversion */
ORDER BY product_code

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_THAW_METHOD_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select thaw_method, method_desc from valid_cryo_methods where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+ 365) order by 1
